description: [``botocore``] Adds support for retrieving associated cases in contact responses. The Contact object now includes a Cases field containing case IDs and reference numbers linked to the contact.

[``botocore``] Rules TBAC GA (Contact Lens V1) - Adds an optional ListFilter (CategoriesAttributeFilter with OrConditions, AndCondition and TagCondition) to ListRealtimeContactAnalysisSegments. This filters matched categories by rule tags. It also adds an optional RuleId to CategoryDetails in the response.
[``botocore``] Adds StartBulkPutItems, DescribeBulkOperation, ListBulkOperations, and CancelBulkOperation for asynchronously loading Amazon S3 datasets into existing DynamoDB tables.
[``botocore``] Add the Unsupported SupportabilityScore to GetCapacityManagerSupportabilityScores.

[``botocore``] Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports the json-file log driver in task definitions. Daemon task definition volumes also support logDriverVolumeConfiguration, letting managed daemons read those logs.
[``botocore``] Adds DefaultAmiList to DescribePlatformVersion to return the default AMI for each processor architecture that a platform version supports.
[``botocore``] Added StepAdditionalInfo on DescribeStep and ListSteps to surface YARN application IDs for steps.

[``botocore``] Adds support for an optional jobName on CreateDatasetExportJob. The jobName is returned by DescribeDatasetExportJob and ListDatasetExportJobs, making dataset export jobs easier to identify and track. If jobName is omitted, a default name is generated automatically.
[``botocore``] Amazon Lookout for Equipment reached end of support on October 7, 2026. All Lookout for Equipment APIs are now marked as deprecated.
[``botocore``] GetListing and SearchListings APIs now return G2 and PeerSpot review sources in review summaries.

[``botocore``] This release adds Migration Planning artifacts as a source environment for network migration definitions, and an optional clientToken on CreateNetworkMigrationDefinition so that retried requests don't create duplicate definitions.
[``botocore``] Adding support to Environment Variables in MWAA Serverless

[``botocore``] Amazon Polly now supports tagging lexicons. Use the new TagResource, UntagResource and ListTagsForResource APIs, or add tags when creating a lexicon with PutLexicon, to organize lexicons and control access with tag-based (ABAC) IAM policies.
[``botocore``] Adding support for copying and tagging option groups with cross-Region DB snapshot copies, in the same account or across accounts.
[``botocore``] Adds the crlDpRevocationEnabled field to enable automatic revocation checking using CRL distribution points in X.509 certificates.

[``botocore``] Amazon S3 Tables now supports migrating AWS Glue Data Catalog tables into S3 Table buckets. This release adds the StartTableMigration, SyncTableMigration, UpdateTableMigration, CompleteTableMigration, GetTableMigration, and ListTableMigrations APIs.

[``botocore``] Release Software APIs- GetSoftwareV2, GetSoftwareStatisticsV2 and GetSoftwareResourcesV2 to list software packages with aggregated resource count, get aggregated software statistics, and find the resources that contain a specific software package.

[``botocore``] Adds Colombia additional information (responsibility codes, taxpayer type code, and RUT issue date) and a rejection reason (statusReason) to tax registration responses, and adds Argentina and Uruguay tax registration types.
[``botocore``] Add Ubuntu 24.04, Ubuntu 26.04, RHEL 9, RHEL10, Rocky 9 and Rocky 10 to OperatingSystemName and documentation update for WorkspaceProperties Protocols.
